scopeNote: Coordinator scope = open 0.0.9 issues minus label epic:design-system (19 issues, Fresh UI lane) and tracking issue #2474.

issues.title: docs(orchestration-runtime): outbound webhook delivery has no recipe or template — triggers ship inbound ingress only, so every product hand-rolls signing, retry and dead-lettering
fix(plugins): every declareHealthChecks returns only the API resource — a crash-looping background child leaves the declared health surface green
fix(streams): STREAMS_DATA_DIR is set by nothing the framework generates, so "durable streams" is always in-memory
[command C10] Publish command and relay guides with executable examples
chore(workers): eliminate 20 private-type-ref diagnostics from the published export surface
test(queue): eliminate typed-queue DLQ timing flake
chore(mcp): export-surface corpus is stale on main and no branch can see it
feat(cli): expose non-mutating plugin and Aspire generated-surface parity
fresh/ai: createNetScriptChatConnection.send narrows UIMessages to text, blocking adoption of the #1583 single-subscriber fix
feat(plugins): a supported KV-only install for workers, sagas and triggers
auth-kv-oauth: parseCookieHeader throws on one undecodable foreign cookie and loses the whole header
kv: RedisKvAdapter.list start is inclusive and pages are not globally ordered (SCAN batches sorted individually), unlike Deno KV
feat(workers): per-handler retry policy with backoff, and a dead-letter queue for jobs
fix(auth): the kv-oauth backend should not install the better-auth tables
feat(watchers): a native-only strategy without silent polling fallback
docs: contradictions found while mapping a production app onto workers, sagas, triggers and streams
fix(sagas): persist the applied key, the transition and its effects atomically, and dispatch effects recoverably
fix(sagas): keep business state in the read model and look one instance up directly

fix(cli): generate plugins refuses an installed sagas plugin with an empty registry (--no-samples)

ci(e2e): make scaffold.runtime tiers robust to slow container image pulls and Aspire convergence on GitHub runners
fix(triggers): file-watch events dedup by payload hash for 24 h, so a second modify of the same path is dropped
refactor(tooling): make generated carriers deterministic and line-mergeable
security(aspire): aspire describe exposes resolved database connection strings with the real password
fix(kv): MemoryKvAdapter.atomic exposes partial commits between awaited mutations
fix(mcp): performance and status tools return zero samples instead of a binding error when not bound to the live AppHost
docs(mcp): get_doc misses KV, telemetry, workers and streams pages; find_guidance routes read-model intents to unrelated pages
service/auth: an unknown or retired contract procedure answers 403 no-contract-procedure; clients cannot tell a retired version from a permission denial
fix(streams): stable producer IDs acknowledge new documents as duplicates after restart
perf(workers): honor Redis listener concurrency and expose bounded dispatch latency
database: refuse duplicate or aliased PostgreSQL connection-string keys before normalization
feat(commands): ship outbox Prisma schema and bounded saga replay/outbox retention
test(kv): Redis debounce-abort contract test uses a 150 ms wall-clock budget and flakes under load
fix(sagas): discover explicitly declared self-composing saga modules instead of silently omitting factory exports

fix(kv): WatchableKvBridge needs an initial state when the wrapped adapter ignores initial
fix(cli): retry transient JSR errors when installing plugins (a 502 fails the install)
fix(sagas): the Prisma projection lists compensating, compensated and failed instances as running

feat(cli): report skipped and divergent browser-auth files during reconciliation
docs(cli): plugin update guide uses rejected package-specifier syntax
investigate(sagas/workers): canary.8 projected atomic saga stalls after background receipt publication failure
workers: lifecycle messages bypass the structured logger and log levels
logging: plugin service entrypoints do not forward requestLevel/responseLevel
queue: Redis adapter has no visibility timeout, stranded processing claims never return
feat(plugins): expose host auth, CORS and listener options for workers/streams startup
